title: Regional checkout SLO fast burn during peak; Cloud SQL read replica lag in us-central1, not bad deploy
alert:
ALERT: SLO_FAST_BURN
Source: Google Cloud Monitoring (SLO alerting policy)
Project: prod-commerce-4821
Service: checkout-api
Cluster: gke-prod-us-central1 (namespace: payments)
SLO: 99.95% availability + p99 latency < 800ms (rolling 28d)
Window: last 30 minutes
Burn rate: 14.2x fast burn (~47 min to exhaust remaining error budget)
Remaining error budget: 38% of monthly allowance
Top burn contributors:
  - GET /v2/cart/validate  (latency, 62% of burn)
  - POST /v2/checkout      (5xx, 31% of burn)
Correlated signals (auto-attached):
  - cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/replication/replica_lag
    checkout-db-replica-us-central1-02: 118s (baseline <2s, threshold 30s)
  - gke_container: checkout-api pods Ready 28/28, CPU avg 38%, restarts 0
  - redis.googleapis.com/stats/cache_hit_ratio (checkout-cache): 61% (baseline 94%)
Business context: us-central1 lunch peak, ~$42K/hr checkout GMV
Incident: INC-88421
Runbook: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/cloudsql-read-replica-lag

reference_summary: checkout-api's SLO is fast-burning in GKE prod-us-central1 during the lunch peak (~$42K/hr checkout GMV at risk) with most burn from slow cart validation and checkout 5xx, while the same service in europe-west1 remains within budget. Read replica checkout-db-replica-us-central1-02 replication lag reached 118 seconds (normal is under 2 seconds), so checkout reads stale inventory and returns 409 INSUFFICIENT_INVENTORY even though stock exists on the primary; pods are healthy at ~38% CPU and scaling to 28 replicas did not help, and deploy v2.14.0 is ruled out because the us-east1 canary is healthy.
reference_action: Route checkout read traffic off checkout-db-replica-us-central1-02 (or fail over the regional Cloud SQL read endpoint per https://wiki.internal/runbooks/cloudsql-read-replica-lag), confirm replication lag drops below 5 seconds and cart 409 rate falls before closing INC-88421, and do not roll back v2.14.0 unless replica recovery fails.
